claims.claim: Share of HDI 2022 variance on the first principal component
claims.anchor: UNDP HDI 2022, 193 complete rows; structure.analyse(). Externally anchored against the 78-90% the PCA literature reports for 1975-2005, which is the only external check this project has.
claims.notes: The headline result. Re-check horizon is the next UNDP HDI release, which is annual.

claims.claim: Correlation between the published HDI score and its first component
claims.anchor: UNDP HDI 2022; aggregation.weights_are_decorative(). Not independent evidence - once four indicators are collinear any sensible weighting tracks PC1, which the README says in the same breath.

claims.claim: Complete HDI 2022 rows the analysis actually ran on

allow.105 countries: EPI's own denominator, after listwise deletion from 180. docs/index.html states both indices' figures in one methods note, so a second country count sitting beside this one is correct rather than a half-finished edit.

claims.notes: The denominator. A share of variance means something different over 193 rows than over 40, and this workstation has recorded five instruments that published a figure without one.

claims.claim: Places the median country moves under plausible reweighting
claims.anchor: aggregation.rank_envelope() over its default draws, seed 0. Modeled rather than measured: it is a median over simulated reweightings, not an observed quantity, and it moves if the draw count or the concentration changes.
claims.notes: Hard-wrapped across a line break in README.md, which is why the checker normalises whitespace before looking.
